snippet.title: Wizschool by OWLOH - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
*** Wizschool is now available in the AppStore for 0.99$ ***
http://www.wizschool-game.com

Wizschool is a Puzzle-RPG for iOS & Android devices with three different game modes and 7 chapters of story offering hours of entertainment!

Evolve your character as you fight to unravel the mysterious events happening inside the academy. Expanding on a solid and proven gameplay, Wizschool is backed by exceptional graphics, music and sound effects.
